motivation: Post-H known-rate sensitivity leaves all24 paired preferences unchanged, including seed43 8/8 native. Test within-H timing without changing class counts or arrival law.
single_intervention: Reflect every original newborn time within (0,H] as H-t, retaining coordinate and identity. Visible/busy births and commitments stay fixed. Recompute temporal prefix/background source labels.
initial_controller: Restore the original complete consumed anchor tree and fixed physical context; original two roots and risk membership retained.
during_H: Replay reflected births through the complete native finite controller. H queues, costs and controller states are outputs and may change; per-class H roster counts and identities remain fixed.
after_H: Use original anchor-MLE rates, original through-H-generated pending residual clocks and RNG state. Preserve the same external post-H continuation for each original/mirror pair; do not use oracle rates.
arrival_law: Conditional on each class count over H, homogeneous Poisson event times are uniform; reflection preserves this conditional law and the sampled class counts. No realized-tape timing is injected.
cost: Same fixed H population; compare complete cumulative cost plus waiting/processing, sources/classes, preferences and leave-one-out sensitivity against the completed original native-terminal caches.
work: Charge new H and terminal native proposals, child CPU, clock reflection, sorting and stream replay separately; keep all partial caps and unavailable scores.
algorithm_direction: Timing sensitivity would motivate four original/mirror pairs within an eight-path budget as a future candidate; its mean/p90 gains require complete development evaluation, not these selected labels.
limitations: This is a paired timing sensitivity diagnostic. Neither a selected-realization ranking match nor a mirror preference flip establishes expected-cost accuracy or deployable policy gain.

paired_budget_projection.selection: fixed before execution; report separately; no favorable block selection

implementation.diagnostic_overhead: Reused H simulator computes a fixed MW drain; its H-waiting assignments are undone, and its extra probes/admissions/CPU are charged. No finite controller state is consumed by that MW drain.
